explanation: Elastic (e=1) ball dropped from y=11 under gravity 30 with large dt=1/30 steadily gains energy over many bounces: 330 J initially rising to ~367.3 J just before impact at step 876, then the floor impulse/positional correction at step 877 kicks outgoing speed to ~26 m/s, pushing energy to 368.13 J over allowed 368 J. Likely cause is energy injection by semi-implicit Euler plus impulse/positional floor correction at large dt, which does not conserve energy for e=1.
